changelog:
v2.6.3 — FREEZER FROZEN/ACTIVE VIEW:

❄ FROZEN apps now show in their own section at the top of the list, count included in the header.

✅ ACTIVE apps show separately below — no more mixed list where every app looked the same.

Good news: freeze IS working — the "App isn't available... managed by Shell" popup you see on a frozen app's icon is Android's own system message for apps disabled via pm disable-user. That's confirmation the freezer engine (fixed in v2.6.2) is doing its job — you just couldn't SEE which apps were frozen before. Now you can.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.2.
